verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We obtain, by computer, a full classification up to equivalence of all minimal blocking sets with a nontrivial automorphism group in the Desarguesian projective plane of order 11. We list the resulting numbers of sets according to their size and the order of their automorphism group. For the minimal blocking sets with the larger automorphism groups, explicit descriptions are given. We also give a list of all blocking semiovals among the results.
